name: Motion-Compensated Block Warping
definition: A method to improve prediction when the scene moves by inverse-warping voxel-center samples of a target block into the previous reconstructed TSDF and resampling at the warped locations using trilinear interpolation.
summary: Motion-Compensated Block Warping compresses TSDF sequences by predicting geometry via per-block rigid transforms, differing from static methods by explicitly estimating and transmitting 6-DoF motion parameters.
